rating_method: Substantial requires directly inspected multiple independent substantial passages, locally specific explanation and bounded uncertainty. Developing requires some coherent source-backed mechanism but key texts or location checks remain. Sparse means mainly abstract, single excerpt, disputed magnitude or no located site. Missing requires no substantive inspected historical account, not merely zero hits.
